thread:
Sasha (Partner SI): Hey team — running into a hard blocker during TheraTech private deployment. Marketplace image fails acceptance and the installer can't pull artifacts. Need urgent triage.
Maria (eng): Ugh, what error are you seeing?
Sasha (Partner SI): curl to our internal registry returns 401, but creds look correct. Also preflight shows egress to artifacts.redwood-inference.com is being blocked.
Sasha (Partner SI): ```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm=\"Registry\"
{"error":"invalid_token"}
```
Junaid (arch): Is this during the signed-image attestation step or earlier?
Sasha (Partner SI): During attestation. Registry handshake fails, then the image verification times out. We also saw TLS handshake errors in the node bootstrap logs.
Aaron (sre): Can you paste the node bootstrap snippet? If TLS cert chain is wrong we might be hitting an intermediate that CA pinning rejects.
Sasha (Partner SI): Pasted logs (redacted): ``[2024-11-03T16:12:23Z] tls: handshake failure: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid``
Leo (sales): TheraTech is waiting on Monday cutover — we need a mitigation path. Can we fall back to prebuilt VM images while infra is fixed?
Maria (eng): We can enable fallback to the signed image shim, but that requires a config flip on the marketplace side. I need SRE to confirm it's safe.
Aaron (sre): Quick checks: 1) confirm registry cert chain (did the intermediate rotate last week?) 2) check egress firewall rules for customer's VPC — port 443 allowed to artifacts endpoint? 3) ensure token issuer URL resolves inside customer network.
Sasha (Partner SI): Ports: customer policy blocks outbound 9000-9100 by default. Our registry uses 443, but attestation service talks to port 9001 for callback. So yes, that's likely blocked.
Junaid (arch): Ok that explains the intermittent auth: attestation callback failing looks like it breaks the acceptance flow and leaves the image in limbo. We should document a short-term workaround: open 9001 to artifacts.redwood-inference.com from the installer subnet, and rotate certs if expired. Long-term we should support a single-port mode.
Maria (eng): For the short-term I can push a marketplace config that forces attestation callback over 443 if the partner opts in. Will need a small rollout window.
Aaron (sre): I'll kick off a runbook check and confirm cert validity. If certs are expired on our side we need to rotate immediately. Creating incident: INC-2719 and adding deploy-bot log.
deploy-bot: Incident INC-2719 created by Aaron (sre) — priority P1. Ping @oncall.
Sasha (Partner SI): Thanks. Can we get a quick sync call in 15? Customer is on standby and they'd prefer not to touch firewall rules if we can avoid it.
Leo (sales): I'll join the call and coordinate messaging with TheraTech.
Junaid (arch): I'll join too. Maria, Aaron — can you prepare the marketplace config patch and cert status by then?
Maria (eng): On it, will post the patch link in thread before the call.
Aaron (sre): Checking certs now — looks like our intermediate for artifacts.redwood-inference.com was renewed but not uploaded to the attestation service. Pushing now.
Sasha (Partner SI): Updated — after intermediate upload and temporary 9001 opening, TheraTech installer moved past acceptance and images verified. Still need permanent fix.
Junaid (arch): Outcome: short-term mitigation worked (intermediate uploaded + 9001 open). Action items: 1) Maria to deliver single-port attestation patch (PR link), 2) Aaron to validate cert deployment across regions, 3) Leo to confirm customer communications and timeline.
Maria (eng): PR: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/marketplace/pulls/342 — single-port attestation toggle, tests included.
Aaron (sre): Certs validated in us-west1 and eu-central. Rolling to remaining regions with 30m cadence.
Leo (sales): Communicated to TheraTech: they accepted a short outage window for cert roll and will keep 9001 open for 2 hours for safety.
Sasha (Partner SI): Thanks all — closing loop for now. Please update INC-2719 with final postmortem once rollout completes. :thumbsup:
Maria (eng): Will do, and we'll add a note to the SI onboarding checklist about attestation port requirements.
Junaid (arch): I'll follow up with a proposal for single-port becoming default for partners in the next release planning doc.
Aaron (sre): Closing note: verified rollback path exists if the PR causes regression. Will monitor telemetry for 2 hours post-merge.
Sasha (Partner SI): Great, appreciate the quick turnaround.
